    The Cleveland Cavaliers vs. Atlanta Hawks game on April 10, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. EDT is primarily available to stream via Amazon Prime Video. It is not on traditional broadcast TV. Out-of-market viewers can use NBA League Pass, while local viewers in the Atlanta area may have options on Peachtree Sports Network. 
    Streaming & TV Options (April 10, 2026): 
    • Primary Streaming: Amazon Prime Video (requires Prime membership)
    • Out-of-Market Streaming: NBA League Pass
    • Local Atlanta TV: Atlanta News First (WANF) or Peachtree Sports Network (PSN)
    • Local Cleveland TV: Rock Entertainment Sports Network
    • Radio: Sports Radio 92.9 The Game (WZGC-FM) 
    Ensure you check Amazon Prime Video for availability in your region.
